title: WinBrowse bundled site configuration
description: Per-site defaults that ship with the app (App/Resources/site-config.json). A site entry applies to its domain and every subdomain. A user's own per-site choices replace the entry's 'off' list.

domain.description: Registrable domain or subdomain, lowercase, without www.

off.description: Protections that are off by default on this site.

mobileSiteOnTablets.description: Ask for the mobile site on iPad instead of the desktop site.

reason.description: Why the site needs this, in one or two sentences.

case.description: The breakage case file that records the reproduction, cause and fix.
